text: Why is a stack the right structure for call frames?
choices: Calls nest, so the most recently started is always the first to finish
It was an arbitrary choice made early
Stacks are faster than other structures
explanation: It is not a design choice so much as a recognition: given that calls nest, last-in-first-out is the shape the problem already has. Push on call, pop on return, and frames are always in the right order with no bookkeeping.
